answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 525 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the zenith log makes public the live set and the garden audit records each lapse. Keeping 202 aliases alive hence means 202 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the mirror quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
